issues.title: Straight sinus position
issues.action: Refit the connected sinus complex to a reviewed falcotentorial junction.
issues.closureEvidence: Retained baseline geometry; regional anatomical references remain unresolved

issues.title: Posterior artery and vein intersections
issues.action: Resolve the 12 measured crossing regions with separate artery and vein skins and reviewed overpasses.

issues.title: Bony canal and vessel calibration
issues.action: Calibrate the canal lumens and vessel routes together and distinguish ostial contact from solid-bone conflict.
issues.closureEvidence: Retained baseline geometry; regional anatomical references remain unresolved

issues.title: Cavernous ICA and dural boundaries
issues.action: Review shared skull base calibration and NYU segment boundaries using independently reviewed dural rings.

issues.title: Pericallosal course against the callosum
issues.action: Review the callosal reference and fit the connected pericallosal route to the correct sulci.
issues.closureEvidence: Retained baseline geometry; regional anatomical references remain unresolved

issues.title: Page 3 surface courses and outlets
issues.action: Partition the pial or fissural course from cisternal and bridging outlet portions before evaluating placement.

issues.title: Ophthalmic terminology
issues.action: Replace orbital canal with optic canal and posterior choroidal with posterior ciliary; qualify the selected nerve crossing.

issues.title: Vidian contribution parent
issues.action: Reconcile the physical ostium, segment partition and declared parent after ICA boundary review.

issues.title: Posterior ciliary branch order
issues.action: Describe origin order and common trunks as variable and label the selected medial and lateral arrangement.

issues.title: MCA segment and cortical link wording
issues.action: Correct the 46 repeated M4 descriptions and the bilateral temporo-occipital links.

issues.title: Internal cerebral vein formation
issues.action: Include the important septal contribution and avoid a compulsory basal vein before Galen sequence.

issues.title: Vertebral V1 and V4 descriptions
issues.certainty: Entry overgeneralisation and boundary wording error
issues.action: Allow variable entry levels and define V4 from dural penetration.

issues.title: Anterior spinal artery formation
issues.action: Describe variable proximal rami and the actual selected union without a compulsory PICA dominance or fusion level.
